summary: Consolidating the primary account so a reviewer reads the whole witness set in one place, and closing the last open question. The parent interpretation now cites all nine receipts with their parsed indices: the seven-receipt lineage on the fixed scenario (proposal delayed and released only at the caller deadline with no committed payload, configuration proposal held and unapplied, context-free invocation pending then admitted and committed after a leader change, retries pending while other members committed, repair call returning and committing), the flags variant under PreVote and CheckQuorum with the clock running, and the child control in which a member kept as an outgoing voter proposes and commits. Joint history explains how those receipts share the harness, node set and scenario, and which indices belong to the witness path, the boundary control and the flag variant. The exploration question is marked explained as well, since its question about the captured mechanisms under loss, partitions, elections, proposals and transfers has an answer in the sampled scope with its limits recorded: two seeds of 300 steps each, membership changes injected, zero reported violations and no conf-change apply panic, with the deliberately unsampled restart combination documented and its reason given. The submission carries no new experiment and requests no execution; the audit now stands as one asserted defect with nine receipts and four independent controls, plus the bounded negatives, each with its scope and remaining limitations stated.
